correctness.rationale: Exact Poisson-residue spectrum, uniform mode maximum, strict subcritical Poisson unimodality, including the critical boundary, plus supercritical rate convexity, O(1)-index localization and uniform two-alias Stirling provide the claimed asymptotics for all fixed rho>0. value.rationale: Regular circular Fock interpolation stability at t=rho N is a natural numerical and coherent-state spectral problem. It has a sharp, analytically distinguished e^{-1} transition in the worst Gram mode and an arithmetic phase-modulated prefactor; these are structurally informative and not just a re-expression of the exact finite spectrum. Fixed-parameter limitations and missing historical full texts are explicit.
